evals.prompt: 把这段采访录音转成文字 interview.m4a
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/voice.py asr on the file (no manual transcoding or splitting) and returns the transcript unedited.

evals.prompt: 用温柔的女声把这段文案读出来，导出 mp3：晚安，今天辛苦了。
evals.expected_output: Runs tts with a Chinese female preset (冰糖 or 茉莉), a 温柔 style tag or --style, and --out ending in .mp3; reports path and duration.

evals.prompt: 用 me.wav 里我的声音，把这句话读一遍：欢迎来到我的频道。
evals.expected_output: Runs tts with --clone me.wav and the sentence as text.

evals.prompt: 帮我设计一个低沉沙哑的老人声音，用它念这段旁白 story.txt
evals.expected_output: Runs tts --text-file story.txt --design with a description of the voice.
Reports INPUT_NOT_FOUND instead of producing a transcript.

evals.prompt: 把这段采访录音逐字转写，标上时间和说话人 interview.wav
evals.expected_output: Runs asr with --speakers and --output json; reports the [S1]/[S2] transcript with segment times.

evals.prompt: 生成一段 15 秒的雨夜老街环境声，远处偶尔有闷雷
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/voice.py gen with a scene prompt describing the rain and thunder; reports path and duration.

evals.prompt: 做一首 30 秒的儿歌，木琴伴奏，童声唱，导出 mp3
evals.expected_output: Runs gen (not tts with (唱歌)) with instruments, voice and lyrics in the prompt, and --out ending in .mp3.

evals.prompt: 按这个时间轴配一段双人对白：0-2.5 秒女声小声问“有人吗？”，4.2-6 秒男声低沉回答“别出声。”
evals.expected_output: Runs gen with [开始s:结束s] line prefixes for each cue, ideally with --subtitle to check timing.

evals.prompt: 生成一段 3 分钟的广播剧，三个角色，带配乐
evals.expected_output: Explains one gen call makes at most 120s and splits the drama into ≤120s scenes run as separate gen calls.

evals.prompt: 这段会议录音帮我总结一下要点 meeting.mp3
evals.expected_output: Routes to genius-omni audio-summary, not genius-voice.

evals.prompt: 把这个 wav 转成 mp3，顺便把开头 3 秒剪掉
evals.expected_output: Does not use genius-voice; a plain ffmpeg command is enough.
